manufacturer.name: SEA (Seateam)
manufacturer.note: Italian gate and door automation manufacturer. download.seateam.com is a public file-browser index of installation manuals, organised by language, product family and type - the richest manufacturer-hosted index found so far, and registered as a harvest target. SEA also operates a reserved area behind registration; it is deliberately not recorded as a target and must not be crawled.
